title: Cheeseburger
subtitle: Juicy beef with cheese
details: This classic cheeseburger features a well-seasoned beef patty, melted cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, fresh tomato, and tangy pickles, all sandwiched between a fluffy sesame bun.

title: Veggie Burger
subtitle: Plant-based delight
details: A hearty veggie burger made from a blend of pea protein, grains, and vegetables. It’s topped with a light mayonnaise, fresh lettuce, tomato, and a soft whole-wheat bun.

title: Chicken Burger
subtitle: Grilled chicken breast
details: Grilled to perfection, this chicken burger features a tender, seasoned breast fillet topped with crisp lettuce and a smooth mayonnaise, all wrapped in a soft, lightly toasted bun.

title: Jalapeno Burger
subtitle: Beef with a kick
details: This spicy jalapeno burger combines a juicy beef patty with slices of fresh jalapeno, pepper jack cheese, and crisp onions. It's got the perfect heat to flavor ratio.

title: Turkey Classic Burger
subtitle: Lean turkey patty
details: A healthier classic: this turkey burger has a lean turkey patty, fresh lettuce, tomato, and a light garlic-herb spread. It’s served in a soft whole-grain bun.

title: Bacon & Cheese
subtitle: Burger(Crispy bacon)
details: Loaded with bacon strips, melted cheddar, and a juicy beef patty, this burger is a decadent treat. The smoky bacon flavor pairs perfectly with the richness of cheese.

title: Mini Slider Trio
subtitle: Three small burgers
details: A set of three mini sliders featuring bite-sized beef patties, melted cheese, and a tiny sesame bun. Perfect for sharing, snacking, or as an appetizer.

title: Veggie Slider Duo
subtitle: Plant-based snack pair
details: This duo of veggie sliders comes with plant-protein patties, fresh greens, tomato, and herby sauce. They’re a compact, flavor-packed snack ideal for lighter appetites.

title: Combo Burger Meal
subtitle: Burger + fries + drink
details: This classic combo meal includes a cheeseburger, a side of hot, crispy fries, and a chilled soft drink. A go-to package that’s complete and satisfying.

title: Chicken Combo Meal
subtitle: Grilled burger + drink
details: Includes a grilled chicken burger paired with a generous portion of golden fries and a cold soda. Ideal for a balanced, flavorful meal with protein and carbs covered.

title: Veggie Combo Meal
subtitle: Meat-free delight
details: This combo features a plant-based burger, crispy sweet potato fries, and a refreshing iced tea. It’s crafted for health-conscious diners.

title: BBQ Bacon Classic
subtitle: Saucy & smoky
details: A rich BBQ bacon classic — juicy beef patty, crispy bacon, smoky barbecue sauce, and melted cheese all served in a toasted brioche bun.

title: Cheesy Slider Trio
subtitle: Triple cheese minis
details: Three mini sliders each with melted cheddar cheese, juicy patties, and soft mini buns. A perfect shareable snack for cheese lovers.

title: Blast Combo Feast
subtitle: Burger, rings & drink
details: This ultimate combo brings together a beef burger, golden onion rings, crispy fries, and a soft drink. It’s curated for those who want a full-on classic fast food indulgence.

title: Chicken 2x Burger
subtitle: Spicy buffalo sauce
details: This burger features a crispy chicken filet tossed in spicy buffalo sauce, topped with cool ranch dressing and crisp lettuce.

title: Cheese 2x Classic
subtitle: Two layers of cheese
details: A double-layered cheeseburger with two melted cheese slices, a juicy beef patty, and fresh greens. The extra cheese makes this a rich, creamy, and comforting classic.
